name: Sharks & rays
description: The seafloor's and open water's cartilaginous predators: pelagic-feeding sharks and skates (copper, blue and mako sharks), benthic-feeding sharks and rays (St Joseph's shark, catsharks, stingrays, soupfin) and the apex great white and six- and seven-gill sharks. Functional group pooling the source's three chondrichthyan compartments; the source measured them by feeding habit, and all three are top predators here, so they are pooled to fit the 25-node ceiling.
